title: guidelines
description: One venue's author guidelines as the writer's mechanical checks need them (Implementation Decisions 13). Every field was read off a page the build fetched or off the research note that recorded that page, and verification says which: a field is in fully_verified_fields only when the note verified it and the build reached its source again and found the wording the note read still there. Everything else is in unverified_fields, and source.md says why. Three fields the spec's list does not name are here because a check the spec asks for cannot run without them: length_limits.excluded_sections, reference_style.citation, and template.document_class.

venue.description: the directory under guidelines/ that holds this venue

guidelines_url.description: the page a human reads; the supporting pages the build also fetched are in source.md

date_checked.description: the day the guidelines_url was last reached: the build's day when it reached it, the research note's day when it did not

word_count.description: the main text's cap in words, null where the venue sets none

notes.description: what the cap means in the venue's own terms: article types, soft limits, editorial discretion

excluded_sections.description: the sections the venue leaves out of its own count, as headings to match; the word-count check subtracts them

required_structure.description: the sections the venue asks for, in the order it asks for them

structure_flexible.description: true where the venue names no mandatory section list; the section check is a warning rather than a failure

max_count.description: display items (figures and tables) where the venue counts them together

formats.description: upper-case extensions the venue accepts, empty where it names none

notes.description: the figure facts that are none of the above: physical widths, fonts, colour advice, per-article-type counts

style.description: the style in the venue's words, for a human

citation.description: the in-text citation form the check detects; any where the venue accepts what the author uses, unknown where nothing said

reporting_checklists.description: the forms the venue asks for, each with the study types that trigger it; a form with no study type is asked of every submission

required.description: false where the venue recommends rather than requires it

study_types.description: empty means every submission; otherwise the study types of STUDY_TYPES the manuscript is scanned for

url.description: where the blank form is; null where the venue links none

cached_as.description: the file under checklist/ the build cached, null when it cached none

latex_or_word_no_login.description: null where nobody could confirm either way

url.description: the template is linked, never stored: no build writes a manuscript template to disk

document_class.description: the LaTeX class the template defines, which the conformance check compares a draft's \documentclass against

statement.description: what the fetched page says about reuse of its own text, in its words where it has one
